name: sign
wording: The word or mark that invokes a concept in a model's semantic space. Signs differ in precision, one carrying meaning the concept lacks, another missing meaning it has; the most precise, the concept's optimal sign, is a fact about the model, so a sign is found, never coined. In the corpus each concept has one sign and no sign two concepts.
